proposal.description: The S_RUN window records the start of an overcurrent excursion (faulted cycle following a clear one) instead of the comparator level, so a sustained fault is logged only on every other cycle.
proposal.reason: With cp_sync held high through S_RUN the run window fills 1,0,1,0..., so fault_count_run_out reaches only 8 and window_trip asserts later, or never when trip_run is above 8, where the original trips after trip_run cycles.

proposal.description: The S_RUN count adds the live cp_sync while the S_RUN shift register stores the blanked cp_delay sample, so the run count and the run window contents diverge.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN, when the comparator at high-side turn-on differs from its value BLANK_CLKS clocks earlier (for example a slew glitch at pwm_rise), fault_count_run_out and window_trip change while the stored window does not, and the count later drifts or wraps when those bits leave.

proposal.description: The S_RUN count adds the previous cycle's stored sample (fault_shifter_RUN[0]) as the entering bit instead of the new blanked sample being shifted in.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN the run count lags the window by one switching cycle, so fault_count_run_out and window_trip respond one cycle late to the onset of an overcurrent and miss the first faulted cycle entirely if it is the most recent.

proposal.description: The soft-start count subtracts the most recent stored sample (bit 0) instead of the oldest sample leaving the 32-cycle window at bit WINDOW_SS-1.
proposal.reason: During S_SS a sustained overcurrent leaves fault_count_ss stuck at 1 instead of climbing, so window_trip_SS does not assert for trip_ss above 1, and an isolated faulted cycle makes the count wrap to all-ones on the following cycle.

proposal.description: The blanking history only advances while PWM is low (low-side conduction), freezing during the high side, so the tap reads BLANK_CLKS low-side clocks back instead of BLANK_CLKS clocks back.
proposal.reason: In S_SS or S_RUN at high duty cycle, when the low-side period is shorter than BLANK_CLKS clocks, the sample at pwm_rise comes from the previous cycle's low-side period instead of the comparator BLANK_CLKS clocks earlier, so faulted or clear cycles are logged differently in the counts and trips.

proposal.description: The run-count telemetry output is gated by run_active, so it reads 0 on the clock after S_RUN is left instead of reporting the run count before the idle clear.
proposal.reason: When the supervisor leaves S_RUN (to S_HICCUP or S_OFF) with a non-zero run count, the original shows that count for one clock until the idle clear, and the mutant shows 0.

proposal.description: A TRIP_RUN threshold above WINDOW_RUN is clamped to a full window instead of never being reached, so a completely faulted run window always trips.
proposal.reason: With trip_run set from 17 to 63 and 16 consecutive faulted cycles in S_RUN, the mutant asserts window_trip while the original never does.

proposal.description: A TRIP_SS threshold above WINDOW_SS is clamped to a full soft-start window instead of never being reached, so a completely faulted soft-start window always trips.
proposal.reason: With trip_ss set from 33 to 63 and 32 consecutive faulted cycles in S_SS, the mutant asserts window_trip_SS while the original never does.
